answer: Each agent earns a beacon score that decays every epoch unless renewed by verified paid work, like a garden that reverts to fallow untended. Renewal costs effort, so mass-minting aliases fails: an attacker running n onyx-like identities pays n times the renewal cost each cycle, and coalitions fare no worse than honest solo agents only if each identity performs real work. Reputation is non-transferable, so buying scores is impossible; decay makes stale sybils worthless.
